reception:
SELECT guest_name, room
FROM bookings
WHERE room BETWEEN 405 AND 412
  AND check_in <= '2026-03-14'
  AND check_out > '2026-03-14'
ORDER BY room, guest_name;
door-log:
SELECT time, card_id, event
FROM door_log
WHERE room = 404
  AND time BETWEEN '2026-03-14 22:00' AND '2026-03-15 07:00'
ORDER BY time;
card-holders:
SELECT card_id, role, issued
FROM keycards
WHERE holder = 'Otto Brandt'
ORDER BY issued DESC;
master-card:
SELECT room, COUNT(*) AS openings
FROM door_log
WHERE card_id = 'M-02'
  AND event = 'open'
  AND time >= '2026-03-14 21:05'
GROUP BY room
ORDER BY openings DESC;
alibis:
SELECT r.time, k.holder, r.place
FROM receipts AS r
JOIN keycards AS k ON r.card_id = k.card_id
WHERE r.time BETWEEN '2026-03-15 02:40' AND '2026-03-15 03:00'
ORDER BY r.time;

accusation.code:
SELECT guest_name
FROM bookings
WHERE room = 406
  AND check_in <= '2026-03-14'
  AND check_out > '2026-03-14'
  AND guest_name NOT IN (
    SELECT k.holder
    FROM receipts AS r
    JOIN keycards AS k ON r.card_id = k.card_id
    WHERE r.time BETWEEN '2026-03-15 02:40' AND '2026-03-15 03:00'
  );
